entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I know summer vacation is due to begin[n]next week, but I have an unfortunate[n]announcement.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We'll be holding an emergency[n]assembly on Monday the 25th.[n]Please come to school that day.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I have an unfortunate announcement[n]for everyone...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We will be holding an emergency[n]assembly on Monday. Please come[n]to school that day.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We've had many strange incidents:[n]the psychotic breakdowns, students[n]being dragged into crime rings...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hence, Principal Kobayakawa has[n]instructed all teachers to caution[n]the student body.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: This is inconvenient for us too,[n]you know? Having to find things to[n]warn you about so suddenly...
